correctness.rationale: At every interior site each copy has start probability \(p=2^{-k-1}\) and the common start has \(q=p(1-\varepsilon/2)^{k+1}\). For displacement \(1\le d\le k\), identical-copy starts are exclusive and a cross-copy pair has exact probability \(r_d=\varepsilon2^{-k-d-2}(1-\varepsilon/2)^{k-d}\). The sum of all local cross collisions is \(O(1/k+2^{-k/2})\), while \(b_1=O(k/n)\) and \(b_3=0\). AGG marked Poisson approximation yields the three independent spatial limits; boundary starts contribute probability \(O(2^{-k})\). An exact rational checker passes 181 assertions at stated finite sizes; those tests are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The precise probability of simultaneous failure (a long heads run in either of two highly correlated measurements) cannot be determined from marginal rare-run Poisson laws. The critical regime \(\varepsilon\asymp1/\log n\) supplies an interpretable persistence/creation/destruction decomposition with a calibrated joint extreme probability, giving a meaningful structural noise-sensitivity law rather than an arbitrary low-dimensional special case.
